mutations.name: threshold drops the square — the radius/area confusion, again
count strictly below the floor, missing every value sitting exactly on it
mutations.find: const atFloor = positive.filter((v) => symbolRadius(v, vmax, level) <= min).length;
mutations.replace: const atFloor = positive.filter((v) => symbolRadius(v, vmax, level) < min).length;

mutations.name: treat zero as a floored value rather than as no mark
mutations.find: (v): v is number => v != null && Number.isFinite(v) && v > 0
mutations.replace: (v): v is number => v != null && Number.isFinite(v) && v >= 0

mutations.name: report the collapse as zero — the silent all-clear
mutations.find: return { drawn: positive.length, atFloor, share: atFloor / positive.length, threshold };
mutations.replace: return { drawn: positive.length, atFloor, share: 0, threshold };

mutations.name: drop the empty-dataset guard
mutations.find: if (positive.length === 0) return { drawn: 0, atFloor: 0, share: 0, threshold: 0 };
